package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for time_since_candidate_via_now_sub: `time.Now().Sub(start)` instead of `time.Since(start)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario685Positive(operations []func()) []time.Duration {
	start := time.Now()
	var durations []time.Duration
	for _, op := range operations {
		op()
		durations = append(durations, time.Now().Sub(start))
	}
	return durations
}
